title: Evaluate reverse Polish notation
statement_markdown: Evaluate the value of an arithmetic expression in Reverse Polish Notation. Valid operators are `+`, `-`, `*`, and `/`. Each operand may be an integer or another expression. Division truncates toward zero.
hints: Use a stack to store operands.
explanation: Iterate through tokens. If token is a number, push to stack. If it's an operator, pop two operands, apply operator, and push result. Pay attention to integer division truncating toward zero.
